Standar error for proportion of selection by bootstraping subjects

## mean + se
data.sem.e2 <- 
    data.ch.e2 |>
  count(subjid, phase, speaker, choice, name = "N") |>
  tidyr::complete(
    nesting(subjid, phase, speaker),
    choice,
    fill = list(N = 0)
  ) |>
  mutate(prop = N / 6) |>
  nest(data = -c(subjid))

# run resampling
set.seed(74)
coef.sem.e2 <- replicate(1000, {
  slice_sample(data.sem.e2, n = 44, replace = TRUE) |>
    unnest(cols = c(data)) |>
    group_by(speaker, phase, choice) |>    
    summarize(mprop = mean(prop), .groups = "drop")        
}, simplify = FALSE)  

# data frame with sem
bound.sem.e2<- coef.sem.e2 |>
  bind_rows(.id = "iteration") |> 
  select(speaker, phase, choice, mprop) |>
  group_by(speaker, phase, choice) |>
  summarize(
    sem_low = mean(mprop) + sd(mprop),
    sem_upp = mean(mprop) - sd(mprop),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Effect Size

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Bootstrap effect sizes for all fixed effects in a glmer model
## ------------------------------------------------------------

## 1. Fit model ------------------------------------------------

model <- glmer(
  unnasel ~ c.speaker * c.phase +
    (1 | subjid) + (1 | itemid),
  data    = df.choice.e2,
  na.action = na.omit,
  family  = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

summary(model)

## 2. Parametric bootstrap of fixed effects --------------------

set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility

boot_res <- bootMer(
  model,
  FUN      = fixef,        
  nsim     = 1000,         
  use.u    = TRUE,
  type     = "parametric",
  parallel = "no"          
)

boot_coefs <- as.data.frame(boot_res$t)
colnames(boot_coefs) <- names(fixef(model))

## 3. Summaries: β, OR, d with bootstrap CIs -------------------

# helper: convert log-odds to Cohen's d (logit to normal approx)
logodds_to_d <- function(beta) beta * sqrt(3) / pi

beta_hat <- fixef(model)

effects_tbl <- map_dfr(
  names(beta_hat),
  function(par_name) {
    samples <- boot_coefs[[par_name]]

    # percentile bootstrap CI on beta (log-odds)
    ci_beta <- quantile(samples, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

    # point estimate from original model
    b_hat <- beta_hat[par_name]

    # odds ratio
    OR_hat  <- exp(b_hat)
    OR_ci   <- exp(ci_beta)

    # Cohen's d (approx)
    d_hat   <- logodds_to_d(b_hat)
    d_ci    <- logodds_to_d(ci_beta)

    tibble(
      term        = par_name,
      beta        = unname(b_hat),
      beta_ci_low = unname(ci_beta[1]),
      beta_ci_hi  = unname(ci_beta[2]),
      OR          = unname(OR_hat),
      OR_ci_low   = unname(OR_ci[1]),
      OR_ci_hi    = unname(OR_ci[2]),
      d           = unname(d_hat),
      d_ci_low    = unname(d_ci[1]),
      d_ci_hi     = unname(d_ci[2])
    )
  }
)
#saveRDS(effects_tbl, "../data/effectsize_e2.rds")

effects_tbl <- readRDS("../data/effectsize_e2.rds")

effects_tbl |>
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
  select(term, d, d_ci_low, d_ci_hi) |>
  mutate(
    term = factor(term,
      levels = c("c.speaker", "c.phase", "c.speaker:c.phase"),
      labels = c("Speaker", "Phase", "Interaction"))) |>

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +

  geom_text(aes(label = term), x = -0.98, hjust = 0, vjust=-1.2, size = 3.4) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = c("Interaction", "Phase", "Speaker")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect size",
    y = NULL
  ) +

Power analysis

library(simr)

## 1. Fit the model ---------------------------------------------

model <- glmer(
  unnasel ~ c.speaker * c.phase +
    (1 | subjid) + (1 | itemid),
  data    = df.choice.e2,
  na.action = na.omit,
  family  = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

summary(model)

## 2. Power for each fixed effect -------------------------------

set.seed(123)  # reproducibility

all_terms <- names(fixef(model))
# if you don't want the intercept, use:
# all_terms <- setdiff(all_terms, "(Intercept)")

get_power_for_term <- function(term, fit, nsim = 1000) {
  
  ps <- suppressWarnings(
    powerSim(
      fit,
      test     = fixed(term, method = "z"),
      nsim     = nsim,
      progress = FALSE
    )
  )
  
  # summary(powerSim) returns a data.frame with cols:
  # method, x, n, mean, lower, upper
  s <- as.data.frame(summary(ps))
  
  tibble(
    term  = term,
    power = s$mean,
    lower = s$lower,
    upper = s$upper,
    nsim  = s$n
  )
}

power_tbl <- map_dfr(
  all_terms,
  ~ get_power_for_term(.x, fit = model, nsim = 1000)
)


#saveRDS(power_tbl, "../data/power_e2.rds")
power_tbl <- readRDS("../data/power_e2.rds")

Online measures: eye-tracking

Descriptives eye-tracking

Prepare data frames: aggregate by subjects, intepolate and smoothing

# data frame
data1.eye.e2 <-
    data0.eye.e2 |> 
    mutate(
    speaker = case_when(
      condname %in% c("SpeakerA-Control", "SpeakerA-Experimental") ~ "SpeakerA",
      condname %in% c("SpeakerB-Control", "SpeakerB-Experimental") ~ "SpeakerB"),    
  phase = case_when(
      condname %in% c("SpeakerA-Control", "SpeakerB-Control" ) ~ "Control",
      condname %in% c("SpeakerA-Experimental", "SpeakerB-Experimental") ~ "Experimental")) |>
  group_by(subjid, phase, speaker, aoi, bin) |>
  summarize(meanp = mean(p), .groups = "drop") |>
  select(everything(), ms = bin) |>
  ungroup()
  
  

# smooth data by subjects ## 
data2.eye.e2 <- 
  data1.eye.e2 |>
  filter(ms >= 0, ms <= 3000) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = aoi, values_from = meanp) |>
    group_by(subjid, phase, speaker) |>
    arrange(subjid, phase, speaker, ms) |> 
      mutate(
      nameds = {
        fit <- loess(named ~ ms, data = cur_data(), span = 0.6)
        predict(fit, ms)},
      unnameds = {
        fit <- loess(unnamed ~ ms, data = cur_data(), span = 0.6)
        predict(fit, ms)},
      unseens = {
        fit <- loess(unseen ~ ms, data = cur_data(), span = 0.6)
        predict(fit, ms)},
      seens = {
        fit <- loess(seen ~ ms, data = cur_data(), span = 0.6)
        predict(fit, ms)},
      blanks = {
        fit <- loess(blank ~ ms, data = cur_data(), span = 0.6)
        predict(fit, ms)},
    diff = unnamed - named,
    diffis = unnameds - nameds,
  ) |>
  ungroup()

Cluster with lm on difference for each effect

data2.eye.e2.r <- 
data2.eye.e2 |>
    mutate(
    c.speaker = case_when(
      speaker %in% c("SpeakerA") ~ "-.5",
      speaker %in% c("SpeakerB") ~ ".5"),    
  c.phase = case_when(
      phase %in% c("Control" ) ~ "-.5",
      phase %in% c("Experimental") ~ ".5"),
  c.speaker = as.numeric(c.speaker),
  c.phase = as.numeric(c.phase))

data.to0 <- 
  data2.eye.e2.r |>
  filter(ms >= 0, ms <=3000) |>
  select(subjid, c.phase, c.speaker, ms, diffis) |>
  arrange(subjid, c.phase, c.speaker, ms) |>
  nest(data = -c("subjid", "c.phase")) |>

Find clusters

# find cluster in real data
data.real <- 
  data.to0 |>
  unnest(cols = c(data)) |>
    ungroup()

#clust.real.pval <-
cluster.real0 <-
  data.real |> 
  group_by(ms) |>  # Fit one model per `ms` group
  summarise(
    model = list(lm(diffis ~ c.speaker * c.phase, data = cur_data())),  # One model per `ms`
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    model_summary = map(model, tidy)  # Extract coefficient details for each term
  ) |> 
  unnest(model_summary) |>  # Expand model coefficients
  select(ms, term, estimate, statistic, p.value) |>  # Keep relevant statistics
  mutate(
    sig = ifelse(p.value >= 0.05, 0, 1)
  ) |> 
  group_by(term) |>  # Group by model terms (Intercept, speaker, etc.)
  mutate(
    cluster = cumsum(
      sig != lag(sig, default = first(sig)) | 
      sign(statistic) != lag(sign(statistic), default = sign(first(statistic)))
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(cluster, sig, term) |> 
  summarise(
    start_ms = min(ms),
    end_ms = max(ms),
    n_ms = n(),
    mean_value = mean(statistic),
    sum_value = sum(statistic),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(term) |>
  filter(sig==1)


saveRDS(cluster.real0, "../data/cluster.real0.e2.rds")

Cluster permutation (only for the intercept)

# data frame and variables for resampling
nsubj <- data.to0 |> distinct(subjid) |> count() |> pull()
counter <- 0
set.seed(74)

# resampling
coef.reg <- replicate(10000, {

  data.to <- data.to0 |>
    shuffle_each(c.phase, subjid) |>
    unnest(cols = c(data)) |> ungroup()
  
data.to |> 
  group_by(ms) |> 
  summarize(
    t_value_intercept = map_dbl(
      .x = list(cur_data()), 
      ~ summary(lm(diffis ~ c.speaker * c.phase, data = .x))$coefficients["(Intercept)", "t value"]
    )
  )  

}, simplify = FALSE)


# get data for each iteration
dist1 <- coef.reg |> bind_rows(.id = "iteration")

# pivot wide
dist2 <-
  dist1 |> 
   select(iteration, ms, t_value_intercept) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = iteration, values_from = t_value_intercept)


## recode based on quantile
# extract ms column separately
ms_col <- dist2$ms

# convert to matrix for efficiency (excluding ms column)
dist_matrix <- as.matrix(dist2[ , !names(dist2) %in% "ms"])

# compute row-wise quantiles 
q95 <- apply(dist_matrix, 1, quantile, probs = 0.95)
q05 <- apply(dist_matrix, 1, quantile, probs = 0.05)

# apply conditions using matrix operations
flags_matrix <- (dist_matrix > q95) - (dist_matrix < q05)

# convert back to data frame
flags <- as.data.frame(flags_matrix)

# insert ms as the first column
flags <- cbind(ms = ms_col, flags)


# convert to data.table
flags_dt <- as.data.table(flags)


## find clusters in permuted dataset 
# reshape to long format (process in chunks if necessary)
clusters_dt <- melt(flags_dt, id.vars = "ms", variable.name = "column", value.name = "value", verbose = FALSE)

# convert column names to character for consistency
clusters_dt[, column := as.character(column)]

# compute cluster IDs using efficient vectorized operations
clusters_dt[, cluster := cumsum(value != shift(value, type = "lag", fill = first(value))), by = column]

# summarize clusters efficiently
clusters <- clusters_dt[, .(
  start_ms = first(ms),
  end_ms = last(ms),
  n_points = .N
), by = .(column, cluster, value)]

# convert `dist2` to `data.table` for fast filtering
dist2_dt <- as.data.table(dist2)

# reduce memory by selecting only relevant columns
dist2_dt <- dist2_dt[, c("ms", unique(clusters$column)), with = FALSE]

# process sum_abs_values in **chunks** to avoid memory overload
batch_size <- 500  # Adjust this based on available RAM
unique_columns <- unique(clusters$column)
sum_abs_values_list <- list()

for (i in seq(1, length(unique_columns), by = batch_size)) {
  batch_cols <- unique_columns[i:min(i + batch_size - 1, length(unique_columns))]
  
  # filter relevant data for the batch
  batch_dist2 <- dist2_dt[, c("ms", batch_cols), with = FALSE]

  # compute sum of absolute values efficiently in batches
  batch_sums <- clusters[column %in% batch_cols, .(
    sum_abs_values = sum(abs(batch_dist2[ms %between% c(start_ms, end_ms), get(column)]), na.rm = TRUE)
  ), by = .(column, cluster)]
  
  sum_abs_values_list[[length(sum_abs_values_list) + 1]] <- batch_sums
}

# combine batch results
sum_abs_values <- rbindlist(sum_abs_values_list)

# merge results back into `clusters`
clusters <- merge(clusters, sum_abs_values, by = c("column", "cluster"), all.x = TRUE)


# get distribution
mass.st0 <- 
  clusters |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(value != 0) |>
    group_by(column) |>
    arrange(column, desc(sum_abs_values)) |>
    slice(1) |>
    pull(sum_abs_values)

Inferential by items

Create data frames by item

# data frame

data1.eye.e2i <-
    data0.eye.e2 |> 
    mutate(
    speaker = case_when(
      condname %in% c("SpeakerA-Control", "SpeakerA-Experimental") ~ "SpeakerA",
      condname %in% c("SpeakerB-Control", "SpeakerB-Experimental") ~ "SpeakerB"),    
  phase = case_when(
      condname %in% c("SpeakerA-Control", "SpeakerB-Control" ) ~ "Control",
      condname %in% c("SpeakerA-Experimental", "SpeakerB-Experimental") ~ "Experimental")) |>
  group_by(itemid, phase, speaker, aoi, bin) |>
  summarize(meanp = mean(p), .groups = "drop") |>
  select(everything(), ms = bin) |>
  ungroup()
  
  

# smooth data by subjects ## 
data2.eye.e2i <- 
  data1.eye.e2i |>
  filter(ms >= 0, ms <= 3000) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = aoi, values_from = meanp) |>
    group_by(itemid, phase, speaker) |>
    arrange(itemid, phase, speaker, ms) |> 
      mutate(
      nameds = {
        fit <- loess(named ~ ms, data = cur_data(), span = 0.6)
        predict(fit, ms)},
      unnameds = {
        fit <- loess(unnamed ~ ms, data = cur_data(), span = 0.6)
        predict(fit, ms)},
      unseens = {
        fit <- loess(unseen ~ ms, data = cur_data(), span = 0.6)
        predict(fit, ms)},
      seens = {
        fit <- loess(seen ~ ms, data = cur_data(), span = 0.6)
        predict(fit, ms)},
      blanks = {
        fit <- loess(blank ~ ms, data = cur_data(), span = 0.6)
        predict(fit, ms)},
    diff = unnamed - named,
    diffis = unnameds - nameds,
  ) |>
  ungroup()

Cluster by item with lm on difference for each effect

data2.eye.e2.ri <- 
data2.eye.e2i |>
    mutate(
    c.speaker = case_when(
      speaker %in% c("SpeakerA") ~ "-.5",
      speaker %in% c("SpeakerB") ~ ".5"),    
  c.phase = case_when(
      phase %in% c("Control" ) ~ "-.5",
      phase %in% c("Experimental") ~ ".5"),
  c.speaker = as.numeric(c.speaker),
  c.phase = as.numeric(c.phase))

data.to0i <- 
  data2.eye.e2.ri |>
  filter(ms >= 0, ms <=3000) |>
  select(itemid, c.phase, c.speaker, ms, diffis) |>
  arrange(itemid, c.phase, c.speaker, ms) |>
  nest(data = -c("itemid", "c.phase")) |>
  arrange(itemid)

Find clusters by item

# find cluster in real data
data.reali <- 
  data.to0i |>
  unnest(cols = c(data)) |>
    ungroup()

#clust.real.pval <-
cluster.real0i <-
  data.reali |> 
  group_by(ms) |>  # Fit one model per `ms` group
  summarise(
    model = list(lm(diffis ~ c.speaker * c.phase, data = cur_data())),  # One model per `ms`
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    model_summary = map(model, tidy)  # Extract coefficient details for each term
  ) |> 
  unnest(model_summary) |>  # Expand model coefficients
  select(ms, term, estimate, statistic, p.value) |>  # Keep relevant statistics
  mutate(
    sig = ifelse(p.value >= 0.05, 0, 1)
  ) |> 
  group_by(term) |>  # Group by model terms (Intercept, speaker, etc.)
  mutate(
    cluster = cumsum(
      sig != lag(sig, default = first(sig)) | 
      sign(statistic) != lag(sign(statistic), default = sign(first(statistic)))
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(cluster, sig, term) |> 
  summarise(
    start_ms = min(ms),
    end_ms = max(ms),
    n_ms = n(),
    mean_value = mean(statistic),
    sum_value = sum(statistic),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(term) |>
  filter(sig==1)


saveRDS(cluster.real0i, "../data/cluster.real0i.e2.rds")

Cluster permutation by item (only for the intercept)

# data frame and variables for resampling
nitem <- data.to0i |> distinct(itemid) |> count() |> pull()
counter <- 0
set.seed(74)

# resampling
coef.regi <- replicate(10000, {

  data.to <- data.to0i |>
    shuffle_each(c.phase, itemid) |>
    unnest(cols = c(data)) |> ungroup()
  
data.to |> 
  group_by(ms) |> 
  summarize(
    t_value_intercept = map_dbl(
      .x = list(cur_data()), 
      ~ summary(lm(diffis ~ c.speaker * c.phase, data = .x))$coefficients["(Intercept)", "t value"]
    )
  )  

}, simplify = FALSE)
